commands.name: flash_and_honk
commands.description: Flashes the lights and sounds the horn, to spot the car nearby (some cars do only one).

commands.name: vent_windows
commands.description: Opens every window a little, to air the car.

commands.name: vent_sunroof
commands.description: Tilts the sunroof open to air the car.

commands.name: start_climate
commands.description: Starts heating or cooling the cabin.

commands.name: start_engine
commands.description: Starts the engine remotely, for cars that allow it.

commands.name: steering_wheel_heat_on
commands.description: Turns the steering wheel heating on.

commands.name: steering_wheel_heat_off
commands.description: Turns the steering wheel heating off.

commands.name: front_defrost_on
commands.description: Turns the windscreen demister (or heated windscreen) on.

commands.name: rear_defrost_on
commands.description: Turns the rear window demister on.

commands.name: rear_defrost_off
commands.description: Turns the rear window demister off.

commands.name: start_charging
commands.description: Starts charging a plugged-in car now, ignoring its charging schedule.

commands.name: locate
commands.description: Asks the car to report where it is; read it with `GET /v1/vehicles/{id}/location`.

commands.name: wake
commands.description: Brings a sleeping car online. Other commands wake the car themselves; use this to get fresh readings.
